stem.en: Kabir wants the story so far in order. Arrange these from first to last.

text.en: A balance shows burning steel wool gets heavier: something from the air joins it.
Lavoisier's sealed jar shows total mass never changes: only rearranged.
Fixed recipes point to atoms, grains that join in whole numbers.
Rutherford's bounce shows an atom is a tiny nucleus with electrons far outside.
Electrons sit at fixed energies, which is why sodium is always yellow.
Outer electrons decide an element's family, and the strongest pullers sit top right.
